meta.name: intelligence-collection-disciplines
meta.description: Run competitive research like an intelligence agency: eight collection disciplines (OSINT to MASINT), signal-to-inference chains, and fusion. Use when one-source research isn't enough.

copy.tagline: 像情报机构一样开展多源竞争调研
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果单一来源研究总让你觉得不够深入。
copy.tagline_en: Run competitive research with agency-grade collection and fusion
copy.fit_line_en: For you if single-source research feels too shallow for your decisions.

howto.what: Claude 按八个情报学科(OSINT 到 MASINT)带你做竞争研究:列来源、把信号转成推断、指出支撑哪类产品分析。发起时需填六个变量(目标、市场、地区、买家、能力、决策),决策为空会停下。
howto.when: 当竞争/市场研究需要多源验证,或你怀疑对手有动作时触发。也可空手调用,Claude 会带你逐个填写六个变量。

say.text: 调查 Meridian 疑似进军仓库机器人,我要决定是否加速集成路线图。
say.note: 对应示例调用,Claude 会按你给的变量展开八个学科。

say.text: 对手近期密集申请同类专利,帮我交叉验证是否在平台化铺路。
say.note: 展示专利簇交叉验证和推断链。

say.text: 带我过一遍六个变量,我要研究欧洲市场一个潜在收购对象。
say.note: Claude 可以逐步帮你填写变量。

howto.what_en: Claude runs competitive research via eight disciplines (OSINT to MASINT): lists sources, turns signals into inferences, maps to PM artifacts. Takes six variables; stops if decision is blank.
howto.when_en: Triggered when competitive/market research needs multi-source validation, or you suspect a competitor move. Empty-handed invocations work; Claude walks you through the six variables.

say_en.text: Check Meridian's suspected warehouse robotics move; accelerate our integration?
say_en.note: Mirrors the sample call; Claude runs all eight disciplines.

say_en.text: Competitor filed many similar patents; cross-validate a platform pivot.
say_en.note: Shows patent-cluster cross-validation and inference chains.

say_en.text: Walk me through the six variables for a European acquisition research.
say_en.note: Claude can fill the instantiation block step by step.
